records.title: 10-K
records.text: While our net sales decreased 32%, which reflected temporary store closures during the first half of 2020, we are encouraged by the continued sequential improvement in topline trends during the second half.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year, net loss was $690, or $4.39 per diluted share.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Ending inventory as of January 30, 2021 decreased 3.0% compared with prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average sales price at both Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack decreased primarily due to customer shopping behavior and category shift.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net cash used in investing activities decreased by $562 between 2020 and 2019 due to a decrease in capital expenditures as the prior period included investments in our Nordstrom NYC store, as well as supply chain costs related to our market strategy.
